branch-dependencies.source:
jtml 2

make Probe
  let x = 2
  let y = 9
  let enabled = true
  get result = enabled ? x : y
  when left
    x += 3
  when right
    y += 2
  when toggle
    enabled = !enabled
  box class "probe"
    p class "out-x" x
    p class "out-y" y
    p class "out-result" result
    button "left" click left
    button "right" click right
    button "toggle" click toggle

page
  Probe

boolean-comparison.source:
jtml 2

make Probe
  let x = 0
  let y = 3
  get result = (x >= 2 && y < 5) ? "yes" : "no"
  when step
    x += 1
  when raise
    y += 3
  box class "probe"
    p class "out-x" x
    p class "out-y" y
    p class "out-result" result
    button "step" click step
    button "raise" click raise

page
  Probe
